title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.15

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.15): ## MiMo V2.6 Xiaomi MiMo's [mimo-v2.6](https://ollama.com/library/mimo-v2.6), a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama. ```sh ollama run mimo-v2.6 ``` ## AutoTrust decision models [AutoTrust](https://ollama.com/library/autotrust-jev) decision models read text and return choices, yes or no probabilities, and ratings for the questions you supply. The family includes 9b, 35b, and 27b-vl sizes — the 35b and 27b-vl sizes can also read images. ```sh ollama run autotrust-jev "A customer says their card was charged twice." --ask "Is this a billing issue?" ``` Note: autotrust-jev is supported on Apple silicon in this release. ## What's Changed - ollama launch now supports Kimi Code CLI — the successor to kimi-cli — and offers to migrate existing kimi-cli setups - ollama launch now fills in Pi's model list automatically so models can be picked inside Pi, and Claude Desktop's model picker shows Ollama's actual model names - Recurrent and vision GGUF models can now
